action.objective: Recapture on f3 and consolidate after the bishop's pin
action.rationale: f2f3 is the only commit_ready move: verified at effective depth 4 with score -208 exact-bound and safety.complete (no forced mate, no tactical refutation). It directly challenges the g4 bishop pin and offers the e4 pawn exchange. Other broad-search candidates had bound=upper with no verification, so they are less reliable. Note the PV shows exf3 Bxf3 winning the pawn back, a reasonable trade.
